latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of DocuClaw: a local-first document intelligence and archival system.
- Extracts structured data from invoices, receipts, and contracts using AI—100% locally.
- Converts documents to human-readable Markdown with YAML metadata for easy archiving and version control.
- Plug-and-play architecture supports country-specific document formats and multimodal AI extraction models.
- Ensures privacy and compliance by avoiding any cloud dependency.
- Integrates with the OpenClaw ecosystem for unified querying and automation.
